QuestInfo.name: Fourth Prescription: Tae Sang's Approval
QuestInfo.2: The fourth medicine is complete. You need all 5 that fit the prescription.

0.0: The Auto-Medicine-Tron 3000 does leave a certain metallic aftertaste, but it gets the job done. Take this to Tae Sang as quickly as possible.

yes.0: If you don't believe me, ask him yourself.

no.0: I may hunger for brains, but my work is sound! I even have a degree! Ask Tae Sang, he made it for me when I kidnapped his cat.

1.0: Finally, I thought Mr. Do had roped you into one of his schemes. Was he rambling on about brains?

yes.0: Once again I find Mr. Do's methods questionable... but the work is good. Our Alchemy Remedy will soon be complete.

item.0: Don't tell me you forgot the medicine! Go back to Mr. Do and get it.
